visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and a dark blue long-sleeved shirt sits at a light-colored wooden desk. He initially looks at a computer screen and types, then turns to face the camera, gesturing with his hands. Behind him is a prominent yellow metal shelf containing various LEGO models, including the Statue of Liberty and a Japanese pagoda. (2) The visual transitions to a close-up graphic of a statistical report. A hand holds a magnifying glass over a bar chart showing percentages of customs revenue from 2020 to 2023. A yellow sticky note with a black dollar sign is attached to the document. (3) The scene switches to an aerial drone view of a harbor. Dozens of fishing boats are docked at the pier, and modern gray buildings are visible in the background under a cloudy sky. A yellow caption appears in the center. (4) A historical black-and-white portrait of an elderly man with a long beard is displayed. This is followed by a sequence of b-roll shots: a red post box, a white lighthouse with a red top, and a close-up of a nautical map with red ink markings. (5) The man returns to the screen, speaking directly to the camera with frequent hand movements. A cartoon female head overlay appears at the bottom left. The video ends with the man pointing towards the bottom and a call-to-action text appearing.
